images.name: overtraining
images.joke: So I trained 1400 hours last year, lost my job, wife, and couldn't get out of bed for three months!
images.alt: A young man at a bar, arm out, says: "So I trained 1400 hours last year, lost my job, wife, and couldn't get out of bed for three months!" Cartoon Gravel God, arms crossed, listens with a skeptical look.
images.note: No cigar (the rig has none); he listens arms crossed.

images.alt: A pale bedroom seen from behind cartoon Gravel God's head, surrounded by floating items: a yellow road bike, a calendar with crossed-off days, a TrainingPeaks workout, pancakes, a water bottle and a choco bar.
